problem: The sentence 'so H and W halve' is only exact when the input height and width are even. With the general formula a 7×7 map pools to 3×3, not 3.5×3.5.
fix: Say 'so an even H and W halve; in general the output is floor((H − 2)/2) + 1, as the formula in Section 2 gives.'

problem: The table lists Conv, MaxPool, Flatten, Dense and Softmax but leaves out the ReLU layers that appear in the figure. A student matching table to figure may think ReLU is missing from the network.
fix: Add 'ReLU | 32×32×16 | 0' and 'ReLU | 16×16×32 | 0' rows after each convolution, or add one line under the table saying the ReLU rows are omitted because they have zero parameters.

problem: The first pooling node carries the note 'stride 2' but the second pooling node 'pool2' has no note, so the figure looks inconsistent.
fix: Give pool2 the note 'stride 2' as well.

problem: The cross-reference 'see 3.4' is plain text, so on a phone the reader cannot jump to that chapter the way other links work.
fix: Write it as a link: see 3.4.
